O01

Optional student achievements

/courses/:courseId/achievements
Roles: studentScope: optionalPriority: optional

Let a learner inspect optional course recognition, criteria and evidence while keeping awards separate from official grades.

W14 optional course link only when enabledW08 published award activity

Award detailCriteria version, evidence references, issued date and issuer

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Request award correction
  • Award, criterion version, current evidence and learner explanation
  • Request does not change a grade or guarantee an award
Return without applying changesSubmit structured request
Permissions
  • Learner reads their own awards in an enrolled/retained course only.
  • Instructor review is through O02; no public or peer award discovery is assumed.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • No award is evaluated or issued when the optional feature is off.
  • Learner sees only their own awards and permitted criteria, never a class leaderboard.
  • Missing evidence shows unavailable rather than fabricating achievement or changing grades.
Notes
  • OPTIONAL proposal only; not adopted, scheduled or implemented. Requires explicit future enablement decision.
  • Course recognition is separate from official grades and offers no accreditation, transferable credential or learning-outcome claim.
